acceptance: a recorded git grep for export const route|mode over each repo finds no hit outside a refusal test or fixture whose subject is the old spelling
forge-cli's template test passes: forge new from workspace-dialect produces pages that check clean and serve
forge-runtime's and forge-control-plane's suites pass on the migrated fixtures
author: rory
out_of_scope: refusing the old spellings, and checker messages naming them (R-9)
statement: Every live TSX page in forge-runtime and forge-control-plane fixtures and test sources, forge-cli's forge new workspace-dialect template, and forge-portal-web's customer docs writes the new spellings: a page is routed by its file under pages/ (bracketed [name] segments for params, index.tsx for a directory) instead of export const route, and a client page carries "use client"; as its first statement instead of export const mode. Fixtures move only; no checker, host or wire behaviour changes, since R-3 and R-5 already read both spellings.
